name: presto-prototype-custom-fees
comment: Custom Fees Request — a fork of ../prototype (the booking journey) kept as its own app so the fee-request work can diverge without touching the shipped journey. No dependencies of its own: vue/quasar/vite all resolve up the tree to the repo's node_modules. A bare `vite` isn't on PATH here, so the scripts invoke the root binary directly (the deploy workflow does the same).
